C0866.title: Company in Laishan, Yantai Hit by WannaCry Ransomware Attack
C0866.summary: In December 2025, the cyber police unit of Laishan public security authorities in Yantai received a report from a local company that its servers had been infected with ransomware and its databases had been locked. Investigation found that attackers exploited a file upload vulnerability in the business system to implant a backdoor and deploy WannaCry ransomware, encrypting a large number of files.
